# Authab / Keel

> Identity, vault, policy, and audit platform for AI agents.

## Overview
Authab gives every AI agent a short-lived cryptographic identity, an encrypted credential vault it can use but never read, and permissions approved by humans.

## Quick Links
- [Documentation](/docs): Architectural guides and developer tutorials.
- [API Reference](/docs/api): OpenAPI reference for identity, credentials, proxy, and audit.
- [MCP Gateway](/docs/mcp): Model Context Protocol gateway and tools.
- [System Status](/api/status): Real-time system health and component status.
- [Full LLM Context](/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive schema and endpoint details.

## Core Capabilities
- **Agent Identity**: Ed25519-signed agent identities, EdDSA tokens, and JWKS verification.
- **Credential Vault**: AES-256-GCM encrypted credential vault with zero plaintext exposure to models.
- **Policy Engine**: Fine-grained, deny-by-default permission checks with human-in-the-loop approvals.
- **Audit Pipeline**: Cryptographically hash-chained, tamper-evident audit logs with SIEM streaming.
- **Egress Proxy**: Enforced SSRF guards, rate limits, and audit capture for agent web requests.
